scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Finite level-regular rooted trees only; membership-query concepts are maximal antichains of the whole vertex poset. Nonuniform rooted trees, fixed-size frontiers and richer partition queries are not covered. The mathematical proof is a self-contained argument checked during self-review; finite verification does not replace the all-size proof. Independent scientific validation and exhaustive historical-priority checking have not been performed.
title: Exact static and online shattering of complete hierarchical frontiers
